General Physician.medicine: Over-the-counter pain or fever relievers (consult a pharmacist)
General Physician.tips: Rest, stay hydrated, and monitor your symptoms closely.

Cardiologist.medicine: Do not self-medicate for heart-related symptoms.
Cardiologist.tips: Seek immediate emergency medical care if experiencing severe chest pain.

Dermatologist.medicine: Over-the-counter allergy relief or soothing lotions (if minor).
Dermatologist.tips: Avoid scratching, keep the affected area clean, and avoid known allergens.

Orthopedic.tips: Rest the affected area, apply ice packs, and avoid heavy lifting.

Gastroenterologist.medicine: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) or over-the-counter antacids.
Gastroenterologist.tips: Drink plenty of fluids, eat bland foods, and avoid spicy or oily meals.

Psychiatrist.tips: Practice deep breathing, maintain a regular sleep schedule, and talk to someone you trust.

Ophthalmologist.tips: Avoid rubbing your eyes, reduce screen time, and wash your hands frequently.
